subject: Scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fintechco.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — that was super helpful. To summarize our goals on the Redwood side: we need a Dedicated deployment to support FintechCo's real-time fraud scoring feature. Key numbers from our side:

- Peak concurrent requests: ~1,200/s during US business hours (1-hour spikes)
- Typical request size: 350 tokens in prompt, 75 tokens in expected completion
- P95 latency target: <=120ms for single-turn scoring
- Availability requirement: 99.95%

We'd like to schedule a capacity sizing call / technical deep dive next week with your solutions engineer to go over throughput, latency optimization (batching, KV cache), and model recommendations.

Available slots for our team (FintechCo):
- Tue 2027-07-27 09:00-11:00 PDT
- Wed 2027-07-28 13:00-15:00 PDT

I've attached a small sample of traffic (FintechCo_traffic_samples.csv) and our internal requirements doc. Please let me know which slot works and who from Redwood will join.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director, ML Platform
FintechCo

Attachments: FintechCo_traffic_samples.csv (csv), FintechCo_requirements.xlsx (xlsx)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fintechco.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the traffic sample.

Camila, looping you in to keep the account thread. David (cc'd) will lead the technical sizing. David — based on Alicia's numbers above, we should plan to discuss:

Agenda (30-45 min):
- Review traffic profile and token distribution from the CSV
- Target P95 latency and SLOs, what trade-offs we can make
- Recommended model variants and quantization options
- Autoscaling and burst headroom for 1-hour spikes
- Next steps: POC sizing + timeline + pricing guidance

Proposed time: Tue 2027-07-27 at 09:30 PDT (fits within Alicia's window). If that works for you and your engineers we can send a calendar invite.

I've attached our capacity-sizing worksheet template to help guide the call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_capacity_sizing_template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing

Thanks Marissa — 09:30 on Tue works for me. Alicia, quick clarification so I can prep:

- Are those 1,200/s concurrent requests single-token scoring calls or do they include multi-turn conversations? (from the sample it looks single-turn but want to confirm)
- Do you have a breakdown of peak RPS per region (we assume most traffic is US-East)?
- Any hard requirement on cold-start latency for autoscaled workers?

I'll prepare a short runbook mapping batch sizes, KV cache hit-rate assumptions, and roughly how many instances / GPU cards you'd expect under different model choices. If you can drop a note in the calendar invite with any additional test endpoints, that'll help.

Thanks,
David Kim
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Marissa / David — 09:30 PDT on Tue 7/27 works for our infra and ML teams. I've sent a calendar invite to the proposed slot: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=fintechco-sizing-20270727

Answers to David's questions:
- The 1,200/s is single-turn scoring (stateless) requests. No multi-turn sessions in this workload.
- Traffic is majority US-East; plan for a US-East peak and smaller US-West burst (we'll provide a region breakdown in the next day).
- Cold-starts are acceptable up to 500ms for scale-up events; primary focus is P95 for warmed instances.

I've also uploaded a slightly more detailed token distribution to the HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/deal/FIN-324. Looking forward to the sizing discussion.

Best,
Alicia
